notes: This lock is the canonical candidate stack for Alpha.118 fresh-world and graphical-client compatibility testing.

All third-party versions and hashes are unchanged from the previously verified Alpha.116 candidate stack; Alpha.118 requires a fresh dedicated-server preflight because the Frontier runtime JAR changed.
Resolved client/server profiles have now been regenerated for Alpha.118; this revision intentionally retriggers build, preflight and fresh-world validation against that resolved state.

Frontier Alpha.118 core CI run 34075488787 passed source audit, current-doc audit, Java 25 clean build and runtime JAR verification; this revision performs the final companion preflight/fresh-world validation on the corrected current-doc audit.
World-generation entries must be present before the test world is created.
Dungeons and Taverns 5.3.0 NeoForge is pinned to official Modrinth version UP9sRfQF and remains byte-identical to the previously verified binary.
Companion integration remains soft: Frontier does not copy companion code/assets, create a second logistics authority, force-load chunks or mint virtual settlement resources.
Alpha.118 adds physical lumber/quarry target caching and five-second empty-scan backoff on top of the Alpha.117 UI/runtime hardening; companion binary pins remain unchanged.
Automated preflight does not promote graphical-client, spawn-density, long-session or multiplayer acceptance.

Frontier Alpha.120 changes only the Frontier runtime JAR: deterministic blacksmith reinforcement and copper/iron-only maintenance payment. Third-party companion binary versions and committed hashes remain unchanged and require fresh server validation.

Frontier Alpha.123 changes only the project-owned Frontier runtime JAR: central warehouse/cart-station logistics investment, physical storage expansion, and bounded productive-freight throughput. Third-party companion pins/hashes remain unchanged.

Frontier Alpha.124 changes only the project-owned Frontier runtime JAR: paid military grades, bounded barracks/watch/citadel command growth and physical post-combat military resupply. Third-party companion pins/hashes remain unchanged.

Frontier Alpha.125 changes only the project-owned Frontier runtime JAR and presentation: RTS operations summary, bottleneck/upgrade backlog visibility, and corrected per-building upgrade UI. Third-party companion pins/hashes remain unchanged.

Frontier Alpha.126 changes only the project-owned Frontier runtime JAR and presentation: paid civic/trade city investment grades, stronger physical late-game resource sinks, grade-scaled administration/market benefits, and progression-guidance alignment. Third-party companion pins/hashes remain unchanged.
